channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cooper Flagg | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cooper Flagg from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Masai Ujiri:

“I have to look ahead. When I look ahead, I see a generational player like Cooper Flagg. He's only 19 years old, which makes him a prince. You see the king potential. It's our job to make him there, to get him there, because he is prepared. He's had an incredible summer, he works out, he has the right attitude, right spirit, hopefully a winner.”

Masai Ujiri on Cooper Flagg, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Marcus Sasser on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Mavs guard Marcus Sasser on his first impression of Cooper Flagg:

“He’s amazing man. It’s hard to believe he’s that’s young. He’s so unselfish. He knows the game.”

Marcus Sasser on Cooper Flagg, Oct 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Patrick Dumont on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
“I am naturally a patient person. I believe in building things over time. That’s how you make them resilient, and that’s how you make them durable. I’m very excited for the future of this team. You have Cooper. You have Kyrie. We have a bunch of young players who are aggressive and motivated. They want to win.”

Patrick Dumont on Cooper Flagg, Oct 8, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Morez Johnson Jr. on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Morez Johnson Jr. on playing alongside Cooper Flagg:

“I think it can get dangerous, us two on the court at the same time. I've been playing against Coop for a very long time. I'm very excited & happy that I'm on the same side as him. Get some wins together. Have I known him before the draft? Yeah, yeah. We're the same age. Played AAU & stuff like that.”

Morez Johnson Jr. on Cooper Flagg, Jun 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Schmitz on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
“Having a magician with the ball like that who can pass, dribble, shoot, and someone with the connective qualities of Cooper. It’s a match made in Heaven.”

Mike Schmitz on Cooper Flagg, May 23, 2026. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Masai Ujiri:

“We’ve got a guy who makes it easy for us. His name is Cooper Flagg. Wherever you go around the world, that’s the gem you’re looking for. That’s the type of guy you’re looking for.”

Masai Ujiri on Cooper Flagg, May 10, 2026. Source: Twitter @hoopshype.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Abby Jones:Masai Ujiri speaks on the future of Cooper Flagg:

“The one difficult thing to find anywhere, anywhere in sports, it's a generational player, and we have one. We've planted a Flagg here. We have one player here that can turn everything and it is so hard to find in sports.”

Masai Ujiri on Cooper Flagg, May 5, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Dirk on Cooper Flagg winning ROY:

“I watched Cooper all year long. The stuff he had to deal with early with all the negativity around and the booing. There was a lot happening that whole season... Started at PG at 6'9 something he's never done.... Historic numbers as a teenager. Well deserved Cooper, we're proud of you”

Dirk Nowitzki on Cooper Flagg, Apr 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
“We got the ball to him. I thought the execution carried over from that Clippers game—being able to make plays for others as much as Cooper was scoring. I thought he used his teammates well…”

Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg, Mar 25, 2026. Source: Dallas Hoops Journal.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg’s return after missing more than three weeks:

“I thought he looked good on both ends… made big plays down the stretch and had some big blocks during the game.”

Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg, Mar 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Charles Lee on Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel
item.description:
Hornets coach Charles Lee on how Kon Knueppel has handled the Rookie of the Year race with Cooper Flagg:

“I think he's done great. I don't even think it's close. I think Kon's done a really good job continuing to separate himself & impact winning & have consistency to him on both ends of the floor. I do think their friendly competition & the fact they come from the same basketball program adds to it. But for the most part, Kon is a humble competitor who I don't even think gets caught up in it. He's probably gonna be mad at me for even saying something like that because he just wants to focus on our team & win games & impact it in any way he possibly can.”

Charles Lee on Cooper Flagg, Kon Knueppel, Mar 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Kidd on playing without Cooper Flagg:

“Next man up. That's the best answer. There's a lot of injuries. We've seen this before. Cooper's been out (before) unfortunately & will be out. There's another opportunity for someone in that Mavs uniform to step up until Cooper gets back.”

Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg, Feb 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Dirk on the Mavs trading AD:

“There's not a lot that came back with picks or player wise. I'm a little disappointed. I think (AD & Cooper) was a solid combo but we'll never know”

Dirk Nowitzki on Cooper Flagg, Feb 7, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
NBA on Prime:Dirk Nowitzki on Cooper Flagg:

“My rookie season, I shot 29% from three and it ended up being okay. We’re not worried about Cooper’s three ball.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Cooper Flagg, Jan 22, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Cooper Flagg:

“An incredible talent. Great feel for the game, size, athleticism. The passing is what really stands out. Last game, he got it going from 3. But until last game, he didn’t look like a huge threat from 3 so you can literally see him growing day by day.”

Steve Kerr on Cooper Flagg, Dec 25, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Nikola Jokic on Cooper Flagg after the rookie’s 33-9-9 night:

“He doesn't feel like he's so young out there. He seems like he played meaningful games and he was winning before. That's my opinion. He looked really mature out there.”

Nikola Jokic on Cooper Flagg, Dec 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg's durability:

“He's a tough kid. Whether he's sore or playing a lot of minutes, he's one that we've leaned on when he's on the floor. To be able to play at the level he's playing, it's just shows being 19 & you can play the game at a high level. He was asked was it weird saying he's 19:”

Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg, Dec 22, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Byron Scott, Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Thompson said.

“I feel like B-Scott sometimes. The old, wise veteran that has the future of the franchise to my side. It’s pretty cool to be a part of and we’re all going to be witnesses to what Cooper Flagg is going to do for a long time.”

Klay Thompson on Byron Scott, Cooper Flagg, Nov 30, 2025. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Jason Kidd on his philosophy behind starting Cooper Flagg at PG:

“There’s a couple of things behind him playing (PG). One is our health…The other part of handling the ball is being able to handle the pressure when April comes around & you’re playing for something greater.”

Jason Kidd on Cooper Flagg, Nov 2, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Russell on if he’s given any advice to Cooper Flagg:

“Not really. I think he’s ready. His support system has kept him ready & mentally prepared for this opportunity. I don’t think there’s anything I can say or do. You got guys like Kyrie & AD as well to put that bug in his ear.”

D'Angelo Russell on Cooper Flagg, Oct 22, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James, Cooper Flagg
item.description:
During the preseason, he has already been tested at the point guard position, and former NBA player, champion Kendrick Perkins sees immense potential in the 18-year-old, comparing him to LeBron James as a point forward.

“You damn right. I said it on the draft night, he [Cooper Flagg] is the white version of LeBron James,”

Kendrick Perkins on LeBron James, Cooper Flagg, Oct 15, 2025. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
“I’m not the biggest college sports watcher in general, whether that’s basketball or any sport, but of course I checked out Cooper. Sky is the limit, honestly. “What I saw, just the way he reads the game already at that age. (He’s) barely 18, athletic, (has) skills. I heard his work ethic is through the roof. Everything I saw and heard is he’s the real deal.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Cooper Flagg, Sep 14, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Bronny James on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Bronny James on guarding Cooper Flagg in the post:

“Just trying to hold my ground. He’s got like half a foot on me.”

Bronny James on Cooper Flagg, Jul 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Ryan Nembhard on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Noah Weber:Ryan Nembhard on Cooper Flagg:

“He’s a good dude, super athletic, seems like he understands the game, high energy, I think it’ll be super fun to play with him…”

Ryan Nembhard on Cooper Flagg, Jul 8, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
“A couple breaks here and there; Kyrie comes back; Cooper is who we expect him to be; and we can have a really, really good team.”

Mark Cuban on Cooper Flagg, Jun 30, 2025. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
“And you see that with Cooper, too. Cooper likes to talk trash. The difference was… Dirk would say it in German and no one understood it. So now someone needs to ask him (Flagg) if he knows any foreign languages.”

Mark Cuban on Cooper Flagg, Jun 27, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tony Allen on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
In an appearance on GrindCityMedia’s YouTube channel, Allen said he does not view Flagg as a franchise-changing player, and predicted the Duke star would not win Rookie of the Year in 2026.

“I don’t think Cooper Flagg’s going to turn a franchise around like that,”

Tony Allen on Cooper Flagg, May 24, 2025. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Paige Bueckers on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
Myah Taylor:Dallas Wings No. 1 pick Paige Bueckers on the Mavs winning the NBA draft lottery and potentially securing Cooper Flagg:

“…I didn’t think [it] was real at first … but I believe God makes no mistakes.”

Paige Bueckers on Cooper Flagg, May 15, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Cooper Flagg
item.description:
And Anthony thinks the 6-foot-9 freshman has a good shot.

“I think what we’re seeing with Cooper is -- he has some similarities to the run that I had,”

Carmelo Anthony on Cooper Flagg, Apr 5, 2025. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.

item.title: Paul George on Cooper Flagg, Ace Bailey
item.description:
Paul George:

“I think Ace Bailey can scratch a little bit more off of his surface than Cooper Flagg can. Which I think both will be All-Stars, both will be superstars once they develop and get to the NBA. I think both will be superstars. I think those two will definitely be the Magic Johnson and Larry Bird comparison in terms of similar body types and the parody between those two. But I’m going to go with Ace Bailey.”

Paul George on Cooper Flagg, Ace Bailey, Feb 24, 2025. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.
